caseStudies.title: Stabilizing and scaling Sid's Farm for thousands of simultaneous users
caseStudies.outcome: Sid's Farm stabilized its mobile application and now delivers a robust experience, with the platform supporting a large volume of concurrent users and seamless access to its services.
caseStudies.summary: Sid's Farm, a leading dairy products provider, needed its customer mobile application to stay stable while it rolled out critical features to a fast-growing customer base. Srinishtha stabilized the platform, shipped key features and engineered it to serve thousands of simultaneous users.
approach: Stabilize the mobile application: identified and resolved key technical issues affecting the app's performance.
Roll out key features: implemented essential features that enhanced user interaction and satisfaction.
Scalability enhancement: ensured the platform could handle thousands of simultaneous users without compromising performance.
caseStudies.challenge: The existing mobile application faced stability and feature-implementation issues that were crucial for customer satisfaction and growth. Sid's Farm required a robust solution to handle increased traffic and provide a reliable user experience.

caseStudies.title: A multi-warehouse inventory suite for an air-conditioning distributor
caseStudies.outcome: Comfort Cool Systems now manages every hub from a single Inventory Suite, with real-time stock tracking and role-based access for its distributor network.
caseStudies.summary: Comfort Cool Systems distributes Daikin air-conditioning products from three warehouses. Srinishtha built its Inventory Suite, a role-based platform that tracks stock across every hub in real time and gives distributors and staff one secure place to work.
approach: Role-based sign-in for distributors and internal staff, with secure sessions
Real-time stock levels across all three warehouses
Stock movements and transfers between hubs, recorded with a full history
Branded operational interface built for daily, high-frequency use
Built on the Srinishtha framework: identity, workflow, audit and analytics modules
caseStudies.challenge: Stock was spread across three warehouses, and keeping counts, transfers and distributor requests in step relied on manual updates. The business needed live visibility of every hub and controlled access for internal teams and distributors.

caseStudies.title: A D2C storefront for a millet-powered snack brand
caseStudies.outcome: A live D2C storefront that presents Crave Better with the same care as its products, with retail purchase and bulk enquiries handled in one place.
caseStudies.summary: Crave Better makes snacks from clean Indian superfoods that taste like a treat and work like food. Srinishtha built its direct-to-consumer storefront, giving the brand one place to tell its story, sell its range and take bulk orders.
approach: Brand-led home page that leads with the product promise and nutrition benefits
Product catalogue with cart and a direct Shop Now purchase journey
Bulk-order enquiry flow for corporate and wholesale buyers
Gallery, testimonials and FAQs to build trust before purchase
Responsive, SEO-ready build that the team can keep updating
caseStudies.challenge: A young food brand competing on shelves and marketplaces needed its own channel: a storefront that carried the brand personality, explained the nutrition clearly and let customers buy directly, while also capturing larger bulk and corporate orders.

caseStudies.title: Subscriptions and D2C ordering for a fresh tofu brand
caseStudies.outcome: A live platform where Tenju Tofu sells, subscribes and educates customers from a single storefront.
caseStudies.summary: Tenju Tofu makes fresh, plant-based tofu daily. Srinishtha built its direct-to-consumer platform, combining one-off orders, recurring subscriptions and recipe content so customers buy fresh and come back.
approach: Product catalogue with cart for one-off orders
Subscription plans for regular fresh deliveries
Customer accounts and login to manage orders and subscriptions
Recipes and brand story to build everyday habits
Responsive build that keeps the fresh, natural brand front and centre
caseStudies.challenge: Fresh tofu has a short shelf life, so the brand needed customers to order regularly rather than occasionally, and to understand how to cook with it. That meant subscriptions, accounts and content in one place.

caseStudies.title: A governed digital platform for a spiritual institution
caseStudies.outcome: A full demo with working UI and backend logic was delivered, demonstrating accessibility, multilingual support, role-based administration and an API-based architecture for future branch integrations.
caseStudies.summary: Srinishtha architected a complete digital platform for Tirupati Shankara Mutt, enabling efficient local temple management and designed to integrate with the Sringeri Sharada Peetham (the main branch) for centralized governance and oversight.
approach: Online Pooja booking with flexible date and time management
Room reservation system for visiting devotees and volunteers
Secure donation gateway with automated receipt generation
Multilingual CMS for the local Mutt team
Integration hooks for centralized monitoring by Sringeri Mutt
Admin command panel for head-office branch configuration
History and legacy pages to preserve institutional heritage
caseStudies.challenge: The institution needed a platform that maintained spiritual authenticity while modernizing operations, handled multiple roles from devotees to administrators, supported multilingual content and enabled future integration with other Mutt branches.

caseStudies.title: A self-owned D2C platform worthy of handcrafted heritage
caseStudies.outcome: A D2C foundation giving the brand complete control over presentation and product curation.
caseStudies.summary: Kouno Dolls, a premium Japanese doll brand based in Hyderabad, wanted a refined, self-owned D2C platform that matched the emotional and artistic value of every handcrafted doll, without the constraints of mass marketplaces.
approach: Elegant, Japanese-inspired design reflecting the premium aesthetic
Custom shopping experience with integrated payments and simple product flows
CMS for storytelling: the meaning behind each creation
SEO-first architecture for organic discovery and long-term growth
Built to scale for gifting, product drops and international access
caseStudies.challenge: The brand needed full creative and operational control, a site that reflected heritage and authenticity, an intuitive backend for content and inventory, and secure payments with strong SEO fundamentals.

caseStudies.title: Rethinking ERP for real-world school life
caseStudies.outcome: Teachers manage classes with ease, parents receive contextual updates, drivers use tap-friendly offline interfaces and leadership gains real-time visibility.
caseStudies.summary: Most education ERPs are underused. We are building a human-centred school ERP that teachers, parents, drivers and administrators actually adopt.
approach: Designed for adoption: tested with real school stakeholders
Mobile-first and multilingual interface
Modular and flexible: start simple, grow smart
Insightful by design: built for visibility, not just data entry
Role-specific views for actual user needs
caseStudies.challenge: Teachers find existing tools unintuitive, parents engage only for fees, drivers fall back on manual coordination and back-office teams rely on spreadsheets despite having technology in place.

caseStudies.title: Inclusive, AI-assisted ordering for hospitality supply
caseStudies.outcome: A full UX concept, feature breakdown, high-level architecture and timeline/costing roadmap, well received by the client, with implementation discussions ongoing.
caseStudies.summary: An exporter and importer with a strong grocery distribution network wanted hotels and restaurants to order through a simple, intelligent interface, even when users are under-digitized or speak regional languages.
approach: Natural-language friendly ordering that accepts partial or spoken-like queries
Multilingual UI with visual ordering assistance
Quick repeat orders with intuitive history recall
Offline-first design for rural and semi-urban use
Backend-ready architecture for future API integrations
caseStudies.challenge: The app had to work for users with limited literacy and language diversity, accept imprecise or verbal-style requests, run in low-connectivity areas and integrate with existing inventory and logistics.

caseStudies.title: A career accelerator for Tier 2 & Tier 3 talent
caseStudies.outcome: Pilot participants are contributing to real projects, with deeply positive early feedback.
caseStudies.summary: Talented students from Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities lack exposure, mentorship and tools. We are building an internship and mentorship platform that equips them to build independently.
approach: Foundational computer science and full-stack curriculum
Mentorship by working professionals
Live projects and assessments with real feedback
Onboarding and progress-tracking platform
Alumni network and community
caseStudies.challenge: Expensive, outdated training; little mentorship or product-thinking exposure; no real-world projects; and no consistent way to track progress.

caseStudies.title: A platform factory for professionals and MSMEs
caseStudies.outcome: Pilot platforms are being refined with real professionals, including Dr. Laxminadh Sivaraju and Dr. Prathusha Nerella.
caseStudies.summary: Doctors, consultants, trainers and small businesses need a branded platform that books, collects payments and builds trust, without managing code.
approach: Professional portfolios with unique branding and content
Booking and scheduling, payments, testimonials and reviews
CMS dashboard to update content without tech support
Add-ons for newsletters, lead generation, SEO and WhatsApp chat
Mobile-first, multilingual and deployable in hours

voices.quote: Every project here brings a new challenge, and the team makes sure you never face it alone. Working across different clients and technologies has broadened my skills and my confidence. It is a place where you are encouraged to keep learning and keep growing.
voices.author: Manikanta
